_doc: All art lives here. Replace any PNG (same name) or edit entries. sheet: rows/cols of frames of fw x fh px. Characters: rows = down,left,right,up; cols = walk frames (col 0 = idle). anchor = pixel (x,y) inside a frame that sits on the entity's feet. scale = draw scale (1 = native px per world px; use 0.5 for 64px PixelLab sprites shown at 32).
custom: List files in assets/custom.txt to stop this generator overwriting them.
